citation: Ge, Yan, and Katheryn M. Linduff. 1990. “Sanxingdui: a new Bronze Age site in southwest China.” Antiquity 64 (244): 505–513. DOI 10.1017/S0003598X00078406.
notes: Peer-reviewed Antiquity article. Cambridge Core issue abstract (accessed 2026-10-11): reports Sanxingdui discoveries; questions the primacy of north China in late 2nd-millennium BC bronze metallurgy. Use for early English-language scholarly framing of Sanxingdui as a Bronze Age site challenging single-centre narratives — not as proof that Sanxingdui = Shang capital or same kingdom.
